psychological_meaning: Conch, with its muted grayish-green tone, evokes a sense of tranquility, calmness, and serenity. It promotes feelings of peace and relaxation, reminiscent of the ocean and natural environments. This color often symbolizes stability, security, and a connection to nature, providing a grounding and soothing effect.
